answer.rationale: New hazard training is required whenever a new chemical hazard that employees have not previously been trained about is introduced into their work area. Ordering a product alone does not establish that it is hazardous, that it will be introduced into employees' work area, or that it presents an untrained hazard.
answer.missing_information_or_escalation_reason: Determine from the product's hazard information (such as its safety data sheet) whether it is a hazardous chemical and will introduce a chemical hazard in the employees' work area that they have not previously been trained about; confirm the employees' existing hazard-training coverage.
